reference.origin: model submission adopted verbatim as the trusted reference

audit.reading: three tiers (small-distance diagonal method with checkpointed waves; block band around the straight line with radius doubling, certified by the banded score equalling the known distance, sqrt-spaced checkpoints and per-tile recomputation, self-counted path cost; divide-and-conquer fallback whose split is accepted only when forward plus backward score equals the known distance and whose last attempt uses the retained exact routine)
audit.fuzz: ASan+UBSan, about 575,000 replay-validated paths over all three modes, wildcard equalities, alphabets of 2 to about 90 symbols and shifted, repetitive, rotated, unrelated and extreme-aspect inputs; six constant-only build variants forcing each tier and repeated band failures; 0 failures, 0 sanitizer reports; only defensive failure exits never executed
flagged_not_changed: malloc result is not checked (as upstream)
right shift of a negative int (as upstream calculateBlock)
__builtin_ctzll (GCC/Clang only; the pinned toolchain is GCC)
two byte caps (131072, 65536) are size heuristics chosen by the submission

time_metric.name: cpu_time_seconds
time_metric.definition: min of 15 verifier-measured path-run times minus min of 15 verifier-measured location-only times of the same executable; pass iff 0 < candidate < reference
time_metric.why: with this reference the editable function is 0.5% to 15% of whole-process time (median 5%), and code placement of the unmodified search differs by about 5% between builds
time_metric.statistic_choice: on 15 recorded interleaved samples per mode per row, n=9 resamples: min-then-subtract error vs the pooled estimate median 2.4% (p90 12%); median of paired differences 4.1% (18%); min of paired differences 27% (81%) with 6.5% non-positive

storage_metric.name: core_peak_live_bytes
storage_metric.definition: peak requested live heap and mapped bytes + stack high-water below the core frame + writable/thread-local static bytes of the derivative edlib.cpp object; max of five; candidate <= reference

local_measurements.scope: Locally built verifier image from verifier/Dockerfile on ubuntu:24.04, docker --network none, two-CPU cpuset, 4 GiB, shared development host. Not a platform qualification. Rows cleared are raw inequalities with qualification assumed, not verdicts.
local_measurements.layout_check: reference plus one never-executed call (same reconstruction, different code placement): location-only time -4.4% median on HW rows, up to 14 ms; difference C-R median -0.01 to -0.03 ms, at most 0.32 ms; 40 and 36 of 60 rows below the reference against 33, 35, 25 for the reference itself, a residual of about 2% of the reconstruction time

known_limits: A body that writes the remaining program output itself and exits removes the retained path conversion and printing (3% to 17% of the reference difference on measured rows) from its own difference; forbidden by the statement, fatal in instrumented runs unless the derivative is also detected.
The storage derivative is detectable by a submission (path, symbol addresses).
Storage obtained by a raw system-call instruction or through computed library addresses is not attributed.
Code placement can still change the reconstruction code itself by a few percent of its time.
